title: Namaz for more Sustenance
introduction:
PRAYER FOR RELIEF FROM DEBTS AND SUSTENANCE

It is reported that a man came to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) and asked for a supplication by which Almighty Allah would expand sustenance and settle debts.

verses.translation: Do the ritual ablution accurately and offer a two-unit prayer with attentive genuflection and prostration. Upon accomplishment, say the following supplication:

verses.arabic: يَا مَاجِدُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا كَرِيْمُ
اَتَوَجَّهُ اِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ نَبِىِّ الرَّحْمَةِ
رَبِّىْ وَ رَبِّكَ وَ رَبِّ كُلِّ شَيْئٍ
وَ اَسْئَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ اَنْ تُصَلِّىَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
وَ اَسْئَلُكَ نَفْحَةً كَرِيْمَةً مِنْ نَفَحَاتِكَ
